scholarships.name: ECU HDR Scholarship / RTP Stipend (2027 round)
scholarships.value: A$37,500 per year stipend + tuition fee sponsorship
scholarships.note: Up to 3 years (PhD) or 2 years (Master by Research). Priority to domestic applicants; supervisor endorsement required. Includes partial OSHC reimbursement for international students.

scholarships.name: Stan Perron Charitable Foundation – ORIGINS Collaborative PhD Scholarship
scholarships.value: A$37,500 stipend + A$10,000 top-up per year + tuition
scholarships.note: Research must use data from the ORIGINS Cohort study. Includes A$5,000 for cohort data access and relocation/visa support.

scholarships.name: 2027 ECU Success Scholarship
scholarships.value: 15% tuition reduction, rising to 20% then 25% as you progress
scholarships.note: For full-fee-paying international students starting in 2027 at Joondalup, City or South West campus. Assessed automatically when you apply for the course.

scholarships.name: 2027 Africa International Scholarship
scholarships.value: 20% tuition reduction for the standard course length
scholarships.note: Currently limited to citizens of Mauritius and South Africa. Assessed automatically with your course application.

scholarships.name: 2027 ASEAN International Scholarship
scholarships.value: 20% tuition reduction for the standard course length
scholarships.note: For citizens of Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam. No separate application.

scholarships.name: Graduate Research School Scholarships (incl. RTP) – international round
scholarships.value: A$39,220 per year (2026 rate) + tuition + single OSHC
scholarships.note: For starts in late 2027 or early 2028. Needs school nomination and supervisor support via an EOI on the UQ portal.

scholarships.name: RTP Stipend & Fee Offset – domestic round
scholarships.value: A$39,253 per year (2027 rate) + tuition fee offset
scholarships.note: Open to domestic applicants and international students graduating from UWA in 2025–2026. The separate international round closed 15 Sept 2026.

scholarships.name: ANU University Research Scholarships – Round 1 (domestic)
scholarships.note: Domestic deadline moved to 26 Oct 2026. International Round 1 closed 31 Aug 2026; check the page for Round 2 dates.

scholarships.name: Monash Graduate Scholarship – Round 1 (international)
scholarships.note: You're automatically considered when you apply for a research degree via myApp. Domestic Round 4 closes 31 Oct.

scholarships.name: Graduate Research Talent Scheme – Round 1
scholarships.value: Stipend + 100% tuition waiver + relocation and OSHC
scholarships.note: Domestic applicants, or international applicants with a relevant Australian/NZ qualification. Round 2 runs mid-Feb to late Mar 2027.

scholarships.name: McKinnon-Walker Research Fellowship (PhD)
scholarships.note: Open to domestic and international applicants.

scholarships.name: PhD Scholarship: Economics of University Reputation
scholarships.note: Project-based PhD; domestic and international applicants.

scholarships.name: State Super ESG for Impact Scholarship 2027
International Welcome Scholarship 2027
scholarships.note: For international students from eligible countries starting in 2027. Check the page for the country list.

scholarships.name: Curtin Global Merit Scholarship
scholarships.value: 20% tuition reduction for the full course
scholarships.note: Recognises academic achievement. Listing via the Australian Government's Study Australia search.

scholarships.name: Australia Awards Scholarships – 2028 intake (Africa)
scholarships.note: 2027 intake has closed; the 2028 intake opens February 2027. Closing date shown is an estimate – confirm country eligibility and dates on the official site.
